leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: A saved customizable LeetCode leaderboard owned by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the leaderboard owner.

sourceType.description: Origin of the member list: followers, following, both, or manual.

sourceUsername.description: Originating LeetCode username if generated from social graph.

autoRefetchMembers.description: Whether refreshing is allowed to update member list or only member statistics.

members.description: List of user statistics entries for this leaderboard.

customColumns.description: Keys of visible columns in the table.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last stats update or modification.
